parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic with a smooth printed surface showing the world map. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It represents the Earth and rotates around its axis to display different regions. It serves as the primary educational component of the globe.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its axis within the supporting frame.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of wood, providing stability and holding the rotating sphere in place.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the globe and allows the sphere to rotate smoothly while keeping it elevated and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
